ubiquinone: n. any of several quinones found in living cells and that function as coenzymes that transfer electrons from one molecule to another in cell respiration
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">拉丁語 ubique（處處）與英語 quinone 的混成詞；因其在自然界中的存在而得名——另見 ubiquity</dd></dl>
ubiquitous: a. 無所不在的, 到處存在的, 普遍存在的
s being present everywhere at once

語感
正式、書面
詞根詞綴
拉丁 ubique「到處」（ubi「哪裡」）。同源字：ubiquity
字族
ubiquitously (副詞)
常見搭配
become ubiquitous；the ubiquitous smartphone
近義詞
widespread：分布很廣
omnipresent：無所不在，語氣更強
common：一般常見
注意事項
常帶「多到隨處可見」甚至略嫌煩的語氣
ubiquity: n. 到處存在, 普遍存在
n. the state of being everywhere at once (or seeming to be everywhere at once)
ubs: abbr. 瑞士聯合銀行（United Bank of Switzerland）
